name: Treasures Under the Sea
description: You run into Ulman again in the Court of Fontaine...

dialogs.content: C'mon, little one, I really don't know how to dive. Look! I don't even have a divesuit.
*sigh*... No matter how much you jump and dance, I still can't follow you down there...
Ulman! You came to Fontaine too?
#{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Fancy meeting you here again, of all places. Quite the coincidence.
You haven't changed a bit! Still popular with the Seelie. And... it looks like you're getting better and better at communicating with them!
Translate what the Seelie is saying for me, please.
*sigh* Please don't make fun of me. I don't have a clue what it's trying to say.
I just came here to do some business and decided to take a stroll by the water. Suddenly a Seelie started following me out of nowhere... again.
I'm used to this sort of thing by now, so I followed it. Up hill and down dale, I even had to row a boat for a bit.
Normally, they start bouncing around to tell me "something's buried here!"
But... It keeps diving into the water, deeper and deeper...

But I haven't got a clue how to dive! I've heard other people saying that the waters here not only have powerful currents, but also all kinds of other dangers... All I can do is sit here on my little boat, waiting for it to return.
But that little guy is still leading me to place after place... I really want it to know that I really don't know how to dive...
Ah, so you're enjoying the unique Fontaine experience?
Totally and completely. A friendly, passionate, kind nation that you never ever feel like leaving. Ha. Ha. Ha.
Sounds like you're about to ask us for help again, aren't you?
Yes, yes! Oh, thank the Archons, you haven't yet been influenced by the local customs here too much, you still speak so directly and clearly!
The dramatic, flowery way some Fontainians talk, I just can't take it anymore!
Every twenty words, there's two respectful terms of address, three metaphors, and six adjectives...
I always get straight to the point.
Gah! ...I feel like even I'm starting to get influenced... Come on! Take this notebook, I've marked the spots where the little guy has taken me.
Just like before, find the Ancient Iron Coins, bring them to me, and I'll buy them off of you at an excellent price.
Always a pleasure working with you and Paimon.
I, being naught but a humble Traveler, have not yet achieved such incredible feats of rhetorical mastery.
I would have thought you were used to monsters by now.
I am indeed! But at least when I run into them on land, I can turn tail and run. Underwater, I haven't a hope of swimming away!
Looks like your "Seelie magnetism" is as strong as ever.
